career_summary: You have solid foundational CS skills and internship experience, but are missing a few required tools for the Software Engineer I role you're targeting. Closing these gaps would make you a strong candidate.

skill_gaps.reason: Almost every backend role expects you to build or consume REST APIs day-to-day, since it's the standard way services communicate.
Many companies host their infrastructure on AWS, so familiarity speeds up onboarding even though it's not always required for entry-level roles.

roadmap.goal: Understand HTTP methods, status codes, and how to design a basic REST endpoint.
Deploy a simple service to a cloud provider and understand core AWS services (EC2, S3).
No advanced-level gaps detected for this role.
Build and deploy one small full-stack project using a REST API hosted on AWS.
Update resume and portfolio to reflect the new project, and practice explaining it in interviews.

resume_improvements: Add a dedicated Projects section - your only project listed is a class assignment; a self-directed project would stand out more.
Quantify at least one bullet point in your internship descriptions with a number or metric.
